paragraphs: Ben He He: see above, Ben Bag Bag. It appears that they were contemporaries, for he brought Ben He He after Ben Bag Bag’s mishnah. In Tosafot, Chagigah: they were converts, sons of Abraham and Sarah, to each of whose names a he was added; therefore he is called He He. See above, Avtalyon, that a convert cannot pronounce he; understand this. There is an Amora called Ben Hi Hi, who said to Hillel (see his entry); perhaps he is a Tanna in Hillel’s time.
